Report to be considered at the next sitting.

Committee to sit again at the next sitting.

And then the House adjourned at 11.54 a.m.

Tuesday, April 21, 2026

One-thirty o’clock p.m.

The House proceeded to “Orders of the Day.”

Order called for Committee of Supply.

Pursuant to Sessional Order, order called for Section A of Committee of the Whole.

Pursuant to Sessional Order, order called for Section C of Committee of Supply.

The House resumed the adjourned debate on the motion for second reading of Bill (No. 9) intituled Freedom of Information and Protection of Privacy Amendment Act, 2026.

The debate continued.

On the motion of Brennan Day, the debate was adjourned to later today.

(In Committee — Section A)

Bill (No. 14) intituled Forests Statutes Amendment Act, 2026, was again committed.

Clauses 5 through 20 and the title of Bill (No. 14) passed.

Section A of Committee of the Whole reported Bill (No. 14) intituled Forests Statutes Amendment Act, 2026, complete without amendment.

On the motion for third reading of Bill (No. 14) the House divided.
